Port's clear — iteration 11 loads on open. All four are in. Let me walk you through them.

---

**Open it: [http://maker:4001](http://maker:4001)**

**1. Permanent delete — separate from archive, and confirmed**
Open an entry's **✏ Edit**. At the bottom you'll now find **🗑 Delete permanently…**, set apart from everything else. Click it and it asks first — *"Delete permanently? This can't be undone."* — with **Delete permanently** / **Keep**. Archive stays reversible; this is the deliberate, confirmed way to remove a link for good. Does having it live inside Edit, behind a confirmation, feel safe enough?

**2. Multi-select & bulk actions**
Every entry now has a **checkbox**. Tick two — a bar appears showing **"2 selected"** with **Mark read / Mark unread / Archive / Add tag… / Remove tag… / Delete… / Clear**. Try **Add tag…** (type a word, apply) or **Mark read**.
Then, in the bar above the list, use **Select all (N)** — it selects **everything matching your current view, search, and tags**, not just what's on screen. See it best in **[http://maker:4001/?demo=many](http://maker:4001/?demo=many)**: type a search or pick a tag first, then **Select all** — the count reflects *all* matches. Bulk **Delete…** asks for confirmation too. Does this cover the "operate on many at once" you need?

**3. Clicking a title opens the page**
Click any entry's **title** — the original page opens in a new tab. Is that the behaviour you wanted from the title?

**4. Preview image captured on save**
Saving now also grabs the page's **preview image** when one exists. You'll see it **large in the review panel** when saving, and I've shown it as a **small thumbnail** on entries that have one (the two seeded samples show it). You mentioned the calm list needn't always display it — so: is a **small thumbnail in the list** welcome, or would you rather the **list stay image-free** and the preview appear only in the review and the entry's Edit view?

Tell me how these feel — and your call on where the preview image should show. Once you're happy, I'll fold these into the scope and we can start building for real.
